cards.name: Medaka-ya Savanna — Elsa lineage and 2026 show
cards.description: Breeder-reported Elsa development: Miyuki Hikari Matsui Swallow Longfin high-fin stock combined with Fromage Kissing, with multigeneration fin selection.
cards.history: Savanna's 2026 show entry named Elsa × Featherlight won Mariage-type Longfin entry 8A with 804 category points and ranked first in the separately scored MVP tally of 262.
cards.lineage: Reported breeder stock inputs; individual parent sex, F1/F2 data, genotype, and exact Elsa × Featherlight show-entry ancestry are NOT verified.
cards.breeding: Original breeder page and official event awards corroborated; different competition scales must not be added.
cards.care: No new water-care claim made from contest or social-media data.
cards.confidence: Original breeder claim + official organizer results; not DNA-verified pedigree.

cards.name: Masaharu Tarumi — 2026 official result
cards.description: Medaka Gachi Battle Korean MVP list credits Tarumi's entry 1C 黒輪刀 with second place and 31 votes.
cards.history: A specific official event result; this is not evidence he created every variant bearing that name.
cards.lineage: Original parent lines and Japanese-name romanization remain breeder verification questions.
cards.breeding: Named stock and official score only; breeding technique and sexed founders not supplied.
cards.confidence: Official competition result and organizer-linked breeder account; unknown genetic ancestry.

cards.name: Larmax International — Red Rili and Volcano Rili
cards.description: Larmax's 2018–2026 Red Rili selection comparison plus its March 2026 first-party Volcano Rili report.
cards.history: The farm described earlier Volcano-series names Golden-Back Red Rili and Golden-Back Orange Rili, and selection for dorsal coverage, shell pigment density and segmented transparent zones.
cards.lineage: Names and selection criteria are NOT evidence of a documented Red × Orange parent cross or Mendelian dominance.
cards.breeding: Breeder describes multigeneration selection and culling; no individual founder IDs or quantified F2 ratios.
cards.care: Do not infer water-parameter targets from color-pattern names.
cards.confidence: Breeder-owned articles; claims are first person, without independent genetic assays.

cards.name: SkyFish — Galaxy Fishbone breeder history
cards.description: SkyFish founder's historical interview describes approximately three years selecting Galaxy Fishbone from reported Crystal, Orange Tiger and Black King Kong-related stock traits.
cards.history: The interview recounts a breeding operation scaling 2013/2018 facilities; those counts are historical and are not verified as today's operating scale.
cards.lineage: Multiple reported source traits are not three directly documented individual parents or validated alleles.
cards.breeding: Repeated selection addressed unstable pigmentation and pattern. Founding crosses and molecular inheritance remain unproven.
cards.care: GH 2–4 and pH 5.8–6.8 were the founder's reported Crystal-shrimp planted-tank practice, not a universal Caridina recipe.
cards.confidence: Founder first-person interview reproduced on SkyFish site; source-stock report, not genotyped genealogy.
